scope: Eleven exact-DOI identity lookups and one versioned Causal-LLaVA identity/original pair.
checks: No source hosts added and no downloaded code executed.
Publication delivery must finish and its exit be consumed before changing shared fetch manifest.
Metadata only informs identity,date and original routes; no methods or scores inferred.
Check direct DOI equality and reject post-cutoff versions.
The selected arXiv v1 must have matching title/authors/version stamp before scholarly admission.
One request per registered identity,no automatic retry of unchanged failure.
No canonical outcome or reader claim changes from acquisition alone.
